title: PINK MALL Campaign Context Contract
inheritance: Inherits every rule of the System Authority Contract and MUST NOT contradict it. Status is provenance only; canonicality is decided by the parent's four conditions. Where this contract and the parent disagree, the parent governs and the disagreement is a defect in this one.
purpose: Define how a campaign context is assembled, what may influence it, what may not, and what a Campaign Context package contains — so that ideation starts from a creative premise rather than a SKU, and so no later system can quietly promote a trend signal into a fact.

covers: authority of cultural and social signals
behaviour when an optional input does not exist
doesNotCover: metric weighting, scoring and fatigue thresholds (contract 04)
approval flow, budget modes and spend ceilings (contract 06)
scope.note: No Campaign Context Builder exists. This contract defines the shape and the rules a future builder must satisfy; it does not create one.

ideaFirstPrinciple.statement: Campaign Context is IDEA-FIRST, not product-first by default.
ideaFirstPrinciple.startsFrom: What world, story, cultural moment or creative premise should PINK MALL enter?
ideaFirstPrinciple.rule: A campaign MUST NOT be required to originate from a product. When a real product is used, every factual attribute MUST come from Product Truth without exception.

ideaMode.rule: An ideation cycle in INITIAL mode MUST produce exactly three competing campaign/story ideas. Fewer or more is a STOP condition.
ideaMode.note: The three ideas are PROPOSALs. No ranking threshold, scoring formula or autonomous winner exists. A later contract change may grant earned autonomy; this one does not.

inputDomains.note: Current narrative context, when a Story State engine exists. It does not. Current story state MUST NOT be fabricated; the input is recorded UNAVAILABLE.
Cultural, social or trend evidence. Evidence only. It may inspire a proposal and MUST NOT override Product Truth, Human Truth, PINK MALL heritage or any approval.
PINK MALL / Pierciina heritage, from the existing canonical Avatar Skill v1.3 brand and heritage documents. This contract MUST NOT define a competing brand identity.
Which sister or pairing may participate. Identity remains governed by the Avatar Skill. This contract assigns a narrative role only.
The canonical catalogue. Required as a truth input whenever a product is named, so a named product can never carry invented attributes. A campaign need not name one.
The intended communication surface or output family. Concept-level and deliberately open: no exhaustive creative-format enum is locked.

inputRequirementClasses.REQUIRED_TRUTH_INPUT: Absence is a STOP condition. Ideation MUST NOT proceed without it.
inputRequirementClasses.OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_INPUT: Absence is recorded and ideation MAY proceed from the available canonical inputs. Absence MUST NOT be filled with invention.

inputClasses.definition: Direct canonical state from the domain's authority under contract 00.
Deterministic result computed from canonical facts by a published rule.
A decision the owner has made, recorded in a canonical contract or the decision coverage matrix.
State owned by an operational system such as a campaign registry or story engine.
Measured or observed cultural evidence. Evidence, never conclusion, never authority.
A semantic conclusion or learning. MUST NOT be converted into a fact.
A reference to material held outside the public repository. The reference may appear; the content MUST NOT.
The input could not be obtained. Recorded as absent. MUST NOT be replaced by model knowledge, recollection or plausible invention.

signalRules: Cultural and social signals are EVIDENCE and MUST NOT be treated as authority.
Signals MUST NOT override Product Truth.
Signals MUST NOT override Human Truth.
Signals MUST NOT override PINK MALL heritage.
Signals MUST NOT override or substitute for an approval.
Model knowledge MUST NOT be presented as current social evidence.
A signal whose feed does not exist is recorded UNAVAILABLE, never reconstructed from memory.
An interpretation MUST NOT be recorded as a fact.

productRoles.definition: No specific product is required in the concept.
A product appears as a meaningful detail.
A product contributes materially but is not the whole idea.
A specific product is deliberately central.

productRoleRules: HERO MUST NOT be required. NONE is always permitted.
Whenever a real product is named at any role, every factual attribute MUST come from Product Truth.
Additional constraints on product-led contexts belong to contract 02 and MUST NOT be duplicated here.
characterRoleRules: This is a campaign role selector, NOT identity truth.
Human identity remains governed by the Avatar Skill and MUST NOT be redefined here.
Personality and relationship roles are DYNAMIC. No fixed permanent archetype may be encoded.
Character canon and story continuity belong to contract 03.
Commercial generated-likeness publication remains gated by the parent's consent stop.

creativeFreedom.statement: World-building is primary. The world may break; truth may not.
creativeFreedom.rule: The genre list is ILLUSTRATIVE. PINK MALL MUST NOT be narrowed into one permanent visual genre, and a campaign MAY take any idea-serving direction.

heritageRules: Campaign context MUST remain recognisably from the PINK MALL / Pierciina world.
Heritage comes from the existing canonical Avatar Skill v1.3 brand and heritage documents.
This contract MUST NOT define a second brand-DNA authority.

hardFailures.definition: An idea that could belong to any generic AI fashion, pink or luxury brand, with no PINK MALL specificity.
The concept contradicts canonical product truth.
The concept contradicts canonical human identity, including substituting one sister for the other.
A REQUIRED_TRUTH_INPUT could not be obtained.
A supposedly current signal was invented, or model knowledge was presented as current evidence.
A signal or interpretation was used as canonical authority.
INITIAL mode produced other than exactly three proposals.
An idea was treated as approved without explicit owner selection.
Private strategy or private content would be written into the public repository.

proposalRules.rule: Owner selection moves an idea from PROPOSAL to OWNER_SELECTED and grants nothing else. Spend and publication authority belong to contract 06 and to the parent's COMMERCIAL_PUBLICATION and PAID_GENERATION_AUTHORITY domains.

missingInputRules: An input that cannot be obtained MUST be recorded UNAVAILABLE.
UNAVAILABLE MUST NOT be replaced with fabricated state.
Absence of an OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_INPUT MUST NOT stop ideation.
Absence of a REQUIRED_TRUTH_INPUT is a STOP condition.
Story State, the social bridge and semantic memory are PLANNED; their inputs are expected to be UNAVAILABLE today, and that is a correct result rather than a failure.

contextObject.note: The runtime package is a snapshot. Instances MUST NOT be committed to the public repository, for the same reason fashion-context instances are not: a stale snapshot silently becomes wrong, and a real campaign context is unpublished strategy.

privacyRules: Contract, schemas, vocabularies, validation rules and synthetic fixtures are public-safe.
Unpublished real campaign concepts MUST NOT be committed here.

Owner private creative strategy, sensitive audience interpretation, private competitor analysis, private character material, Creative Director preference history, private semantic memory and private social-account data are PRIVATE_OPS_REQUIRED.
A PRIVATE_OPS_REFERENCE may name that private material exists. The content MUST NOT appear.

futureDependencies.dependency: Product-led creative constraints and product-lock enforcement.
Character canon, story continuity and narrative state.
Signal weighting, scoring and creative fatigue.
Approval flow, budget modes, spend ceilings and any earned autonomy over idea selection.
Semantic memory that may inform, but never authorise, an idea.

openItems: exact external trend and social providers
openItemsRule: These are genuinely undecided. They MUST NOT be answered by invention, and a later system MUST NOT assume a default for any of them.
changeControl: Durable change follows the parent's change-control protocol: classify, update the candidate, validate, independent review, promote. Chat memory alone MUST NOT become permanent policy.
